svg.title: Discrete time-causal VQ-VAE architecture
svg.desc: Encoder-quantizer-decoder pipeline of the causal VQ tokenizer with dilated causal convolutions, VIX conditioning, and a no-anticipation receptive-field schematic.
svg.text: condition c (VIX) — broadcast over T, concatenated channel-wise at ⊕
left-padding = dilation × (kernel−1) — output at time t depends only on inputs ≤ t
schematic (2 taps shown per node for legibility; actual kernel=3) · true receptive field = 1+2·Σd = 31 timesteps for d=1,2,4,8
